recipes.title: Scallion Oil Noodles with Fried Egg
steps: Cut the scallions into 2–3 inch segments, separating whites from greens, and thinly julienne each. Thinly slice the shallots.

Put the shallots and scallion whites in a cold wok with the oil. Cook on medium for 8–10 minutes, then add the greens and cook 5–7 minutes more until golden and crispy. Strain, keeping the oil and the crispy bits separately.
In the wok, simmer 3 tbsp of the scallion oil with the light soy, dark soy, oyster sauce and sugar on low for 2 minutes.
Boil the fresh noodles according to the package, drain and toss in the sauce until fully coated.
Plate, top with the crispy scallion bits and an egg shallow-fried in a little of the scallion oil.
recipes.notes: Recipe amounts are the creator's; macros are estimated per bowl with one egg, using about 3 tbsp of the oil (the rest keeps in a jar for other dishes).
